parents.subject: Russian, East European and Eurasian Studies

ns2:course.label: Senior Seminar
ns2:course.description: (REES 295) Interdisciplinary seminar normally taken in the senior year. Involving faculty in a number of disciplines, this course approaches understanding Russia and Eastern Europe, and the methodologies of its study, through questions of identities, cultural values, and change. Taught in conjunction with REES 550. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Declared major in Russian and East European Studies or consent of instructor; junior or senior standing.
